Name: m1_welcome
Title: Welcome to Calgary
Brief: Marcy Delorme needs a trustworthy driver for a simple first-day job: pick up a bakery order and deliver it downtown.

Name: m2_delivery
Title: Downtown Delivery
Brief: A signed contract has to cross downtown before the law office loading dock closes. Traffic and tight parking are the real enemy.

Name: m3_missing
Title: The Missing Vehicle
Brief: Owen Whitaker lost a pickup from his yard. Search the industrial vehicle yards, then decide what to do with what you find.

Name: m4_highway
Title: Highway Pressure
Brief: Prove yourself on Prairie Trail: six checkpoints against the clock, through live traffic, in a borrowed Stampede RS.

Name: m5_rival
Title: The Rival Contract
Brief: Redline Hauling is undercutting Whitaker Freight on a big contract. Negotiate, out-drive Dante Kowalczyk, or wreck his convoy.

Name: m6_afterdark
Title: After Dark
Brief: One package, three buyers, and a long night. Collect it, lose Dante's crew and the police, then decide who gets it.
